desc: 隐形空气衣正背双视图，三行空线亮点位，布纹与车缝微距，三色并列选码
leaf: 男士免烫长袖正装衬衫
name: 挺括空气衣长袖正装衬衫款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用纯白底隐形空气衣正面版图形成立即识别的正装衬衫印象
主图一秒法则：以三条横线引导位把三条核心主张一次讲完，主张文字全部留为占位
shots.textZone: right 45% band, three stacked hairline rules each followed by one short label reading 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 in graphite #2C333A

shots.intent: 放大出差后领口塌软起皱的尴尬，用同框双态反衬挺括领型
让上班族一眼代入：颈下裁切的通用男模把衬衫穿进晨间通勤动线
补上背面信息，用后过肩缝与圆弧下摆证明版型与活动量，消除尺码疑虑
用布面涡旋微距证明织纹细腻与垂顺手感，替面料主张提供可见证据
并列同款多色让买家自选，色名与数量一律由买家素材决定
收口去风险：以领座、门襟与扣眼的双线车缝特写充当工艺证据，信任位留空不编造资质

style.backgroundSystem: seamless porcelain white #FFFFFF sweep for front and back air-form packshots and the variant row, cool mist grey #EAEFF4 for the ruled callout screen, deeper steel greys for pain-point and scene depth, cool porcelain #E9EEF3 for the stitch macro
style.iconSystem: hairline rules, blank caption slots and one letterless seal ring in graphite #2C333A, no filled badges and no pictograms
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key cool studio light with a front or front-left key and a soft fill card, gentle contact shadow under the hem, soft skimming light only on weave and stitch macros, no harsh speculars, 5600K daylight balance in the scene screen
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent crisp air-form menswear visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless porcelain white #FFFFFF, cool mist grey #EAEFF4, graphite text #2C333A and one steel-blue accent #3E5C76; bright even high-key cool studio lighting with a front-left key, soft fill and gentle contact shadows, soft skimming light reserved for weave and stitch macros; modern geometric sans-serif; hairline rules and letterless blank slots instead of badges; clean high-end apparel photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable squared-collar hero scale on an invisible ghost form; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no color palette changes beyond #FFFFFF, #EAEFF4, #2C333A and #3E5C76, the only reserved neutrals being steel #D6DCE3, scene grey #B9C3CC and the macro fields #F2F5F8 and #E9EEF3
no mixed fonts, no serif, script or brush lettering
no random scenic backgrounds or gradient sweeps
no inconsistent lighting or warm cast drift between shots
no collar-shape, cuff-fold or placket drift between shots
no visible mannequin, hanger or model identity
style.presentationRules: the shirt reads as one and the same garment across the set: collar spread and squared, placket straight, cuffs folded back identically, stable hero scale on an invisible ghost form
style.surfaceSystem: matte seamless studio paper #FFFFFF and cool mist board #EAEFF4, fabric laid directly on the same field for macros
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, hairline ruled callout slots only, all garment lettering supplied as placeholders
